title: When Model Rankings Move Without Model Change: A Registered Audit of Evaluation Contracts in Neural Prediction Pipelines
abstract: arXiv:2611.04099v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Evaluation reports cite sliced differences, most prominently the intra-inter gap in document-level relation extraction (DocRE), as capability evidence. Such gap readings are joint properties of models and evaluation contracts: scoring function, gold version, threshold, output format, and prompt language. With predictions frozen, switching only the gold reverses a method ordering (+0.0363, CI excluding zero; retrained stand-ins), leaving it tie-level. The flip survives Holm correction (exploratory tier); ten of thirteen flips share one contrast (fixed vs decoded threshold). Rename-only revisions cannot move a reading (Delta = 0); re-annotation moves it +0.862 UD points. We formalize this as an evaluation leverage account centered on a rank-flip condition. Constructively, the audited evaluation reading (AER; post-freeze) aggregates a comparison over declared contracts, declares ties when they disagree, prescribes seeds, and filters unv

translated_title: 当模型排名在模型未变的情况下发生变动：对神经预测管线中评估契约的注册审计
translated_abstract: 评估报告常将切片差异（最突出的是文档级关系抽取中的 intra-inter 差距）引用为能力证据。此类差距读数是模型与评估契约的共同属性，涉及评分函数、黄金标准版本、阈值、输出格式和提示语言。在预测结果冻结的前提下，仅更换黄金标准即可逆转方法排序（+0.0363，置信区间不含零；基于重新训练的替代模型），使其降为平局水平。该翻转经 Holm 校正后依然成立（探索性层级）；十三次翻转中有十次共享同一对比因素（固定阈值与解码阈值之别）。仅重命名的修订不会改变读数（Delta = 0），而重新标注则使读数移动 +0.862 个 UD 点。作者将这一现象形式化为以排名翻转条件为核心的“评估杠杆”解释框架。在建设性方面，作者提出冻结后的经审计评估读数（AER），其聚合跨已声明契约的比较结果，在契约间不一致时判定为平局，规定随机种子，并过滤未经验证的……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 论文通过注册审计证明，在不改变模型本身的情况下，仅调整评估契约（如黄金标准、阈值等）就足以逆转模型排名，并提出冻结后跨契约聚合的审计式评估读数（AER）以稳健地报告评估结果。
en_tdlr: Through a registered audit, the paper shows that model rankings can flip without any model change merely by altering evaluation contracts (e.g., gold version or threshold), and proposes a post-freeze audited evaluation reading (AER) that aggregates across declared contracts and reports ties when they disagree.
